name: Graphite
title: Graphite: free Adobe Illustrator alternative
hook: Adobe Illustrator charges you twenty three dollars a month to draw logos and vector art. This app does it for free.
job: Draws vector art in a browser

features.intro: It's a vector editor that lives in your browser.
features.say: Draw shapes on layers, zoom in forever without it getting blurry, and export at any resolution.
Everything is nondestructive, so you tweak a slider later instead of redrawing.

install_line: It runs in any browser. Nothing to install, just open the editor.
caption:
Adobe Illustrator charges $22.99/month. Graphite draws vector art for free 🎨

✅ Vector editing with layers, in your browser
✅ Zoom in forever and export at any resolution
✅ Nondestructive: change a slider instead of redrawing
✅ No subscription, 100% free

ℹ️ Graphite is still in alpha, so expect rough edges. The web app is live now; desktop apps are still in testing
💻 Any browser

Comment "ART" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
